description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the BuzzPostShareAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It contains tests for retrieving all shares, and confirmation that create, delete, and validation rule methods are not implemented. The tests involve setting up fixtures, mocking services, and asserting API behaviors.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the OrangeHRM BuzzPostShareAPI functionalities, including retrieval of all shares and ensuring certain methods throw not implemented exceptions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests that the 'getAll' endpoint returns expected results based on provided test cases.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Confirms that calling 'create' method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the 'delete' method is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a not implemented exception.
